questionText: Which description of J, K, and L is correct?
choices: J and K are different elements; L is neutral
J and K are isotopes of the same element; L is a negative ion of that element
All three are neutral isotopes with equal mass
L is a new element because it has more electrons
explanation: All have 8 protons, so they are the same element. J and K differ in neutrons and are isotopes. L has two more electrons than protons and is a negative ion; electron count does not change its element.

questionText: Which statement best explains the dark leaf result?
choices: Plants respire only when no oxygen is available
Chloroplasts produce oxygen only in darkness
Respiration can consume oxygen without photosynthesis replacing it
The result proves the leaf is not alive
explanation: Plants perform cellular respiration in darkness as well as light. In darkness, oxygen production by photosynthesis does not offset oxygen consumption. Stable no-leaf controls argue against a chamber-wide oxygen drift.
